facts.statement: Courseware introduces the 2021 integration and 2022 credit-information inclusion. It predates the later cooperative-bank and 2026 replacement notifications.
2021 scheme replaced the three earlier schemes with savings for specified pending proceedings. Source contains August 2022 amendments; later notifications must be read separately.
RBI announced the final 2026 scheme on 16 January 2026, stating commencement from 1 July 2026.

facts.locator: clause 1(2), PDF p.1; clause 20, PDF p.17
facts.statement: 2026 scheme commences on 1 July 2026 and repeals 2021 then; specified complaints received before July, resulting appeals and execution of awards remain governed by 2021 and instructions. Notification before cutoff is distinct from later commencement.

payload.title: Choose the scheme version before applying its procedure
payload.core_explanation_md:
This unit examines the **2021 scheme as at 30 June 2026**, read with the identified amendments and coverage notification. It is not a current instruction to file a complaint under an obsolete scheme. A question about a historical complaint needs its date and applicable version; a later rule should not silently replace that question answer.

RBI notified the 2026 scheme in January 2026, with commencement on 1 July 2026. Notification and commencement therefore fall on opposite sides of this exam cutoff. The existence of a pre-cutoff announcement is itself relevant evidence, but does not mean every new operative clause was already in force on 30 June. Review of exam treatment of announced future-effective changes remains required.

self_check.prompt_text: Does notification before cutoff automatically mean every new procedure was already operative at cutoff?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The notification date and the specified commencement date must be distinguished.

payload.title: Repeal does not erase the stated pending-case savings
payload.core_explanation_md:
The 2026 scheme clause 20 expressly preserves the stated treatment of complaints received before 1 July 2026, appeals arising from decisions under the earlier scheme and execution of its awards. A file crossing the transition needs the relevant receipt and proceeding facts. Do not assume the calendar changing automatically moves every older case to the new procedure.

The 2021 scheme itself had savings when it replaced the three previous schemes. This illustrates why the operative scheme, the proceeding and the transition clause must be read together. Current-reference study and an exam-session question can use different legal snapshots; the version should always be visible.

self_check.prompt_text: What should be checked before moving an older complaint to a replacement scheme?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The receipt/proceeding facts and the replacement scheme express savings provision.
